content.rendered:
Join us for Supply Night on August 30th, 4:00-6:00pm. This event is an excellent opportunity to meet teachers, reconnect with and make new friends, and ensure your students’ school year gets off to a great start!

Beat the first day rush! You can also deposit lunch money into your child’s lunch account! Or pay online at:  https://sherwood.k12.or.us/resources/online-payment-system/

We also encourage you to bring any daily medications, Epi-Pens, inhalers, or over the counter medications your child may need at school to Supply Night. Required forms are available on the Health Services web page, as well as in the office.
